title: Enterprise Multi-Tenant LLM Inference Serving Stack Selection & TCO Crossover Guide: vLLM V1 vs. SGLang vs. TensorRT-LLM vs. Azure AI Foundry Managed Endpoints

workload_basis.workload_profile: Multi-Turn Agentic Tool Use (75% Shared Prefix) + Multi-Model Enterprise RAG

tiers.tier: Tier 1: 100% Cloud Managed Endpoints (Azure AI Foundry / Bedrock Managed Dedicated Instances)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Optimal for <=8-12 GPU teams where saving 1-2 SRE salaries outweighs raw GPU rental premiums

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Self-Hosted Pure TensorRT-LLM (Ahead-of-Time Compiled Engines + High C++ Maintenance Overhead)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Single-model hyperscale fleets (>128 homogeneous NVIDIA GPUs) with dedicated compiler engineers

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Standardized Self-Hosted vLLM V1 (ZMQ Multiprocess + Piecewise CUDA Graph + 100+ Model Coverage)
tiers.recommended_scenario: General-purpose multi-model MaaS across heterogeneous GPUs (NVIDIA, AMD MI300X/MI325X, Cloud TPU)

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Hybrid Dual-Engine K8s (SGLang for MoE/Agents + vLLM V1 for General Models + Foundry Spillover)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Enterprise production gold standard delivering 2,480 tok/s/GPU and -62.9% fully-loaded $/1M tokens
